{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --nodes=1
#SBATCH --ntasks-per-node=6
#SBATCH --mem-per-cpu=24gb
#SBATCH --time=00:05:00
#SBATCH --account=open
#SBATCH --output=logs/depth.sid.CENPK.100K.log.out
#SBATCH --error=logs/depth.sid.CENPK.100K.log.err
#SBATCH --array=1-1000

module load gcc/8.3.1
module load bedtools/2.27.1
module load bwa/0.7.15
module load samtools/1.5
module load anaconda3
source activate genopipe

# FIRST CHANGE PATH TO EXECUTE
WRK=/path/to/GenoPipe/paper/SyntheticStrain
cd $WRK

INFO=`sed "3q;d" depth_simulations.txt`
LOCUS=`awk '{print $1}'  <(echo $INFO)`
DEPTH=`awk '{print $2}'  <(echo $INFO)`
BASE=`awk '{print $3}'  <(echo $INFO)`

REF=`echo $LOCUS | awk -F'_' '{print $1}'`
SEED=$(($BASE+$SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID))

OUTPUT=$WRK/results/$LOCUS\_$DEPTH
BAM=$WRK/results/$LOCUS\_$DEPTH/BAM/Simulation_$SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID.bam
TEMP=$WRK/temp3-$SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID

[ -d $OUTPUT/ID ] || mkdir $OUTPUT/ID
[ -d logs ] || mkdir logs
[ -d $TEMP ] || mkdir $TEMP

#Check that BAM file was generated first
if [ ! -f $BAM ];
then
	echo "BAM input for ${LOCUS}_${DEPTH}_${SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID} does not exist. Exiting."
	exit
fi
#Check that BAM Index file exists
if [ ! -f $BAM.bai ];
then
	echo "BAI missing for for ${LOCUS}_${DEPTH}_${SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID}. Exiting."
	exit
fi

# Set-up Temp directory
cd $TEMP
echo $BAM
ln -s $BAM
ln -s $BAM.bai

GENOME=$WRK/../input/$REF.fa
DATABASE=$WRK/../db/$REF\_VCF
GENOPIPE=$WRK/../..

## Execute Single StrainID and record time
cd $GENOPIPE/StrainID
echo "**Begin executing StrainID for ${LOCUS}_${DEPTH}..."
{ time bash identify-Strain.sh -i $TEMP -g $GENOME -v $DATABASE -o $OUTPUT/ID -s $SEED > $OUTPUT/ID/Simulation_$SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID.std ; } 2> $OUTPUT/ID/Simulation_$SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID.time
echo "...single StrainID for ${LOCUS} ${DEPTH} finished."
cd $WRK

## Clean-up
rm -r $TEMP
"
}
